description: WorldPop publishes open high-resolution gridded population data. Its Global2 population count datasets (release R2025A version 1) cover every country for each year from 2015 to 2030, at 100 metre and 1 km resolution per country and as 1 km global mosaics, produced with top-down methods that disaggregate administrative census and projection counts to grid cells classified as settled, with age and sex breakdowns and options matched to UN national estimates. Bespoke bottom-up country estimates are offered separately through the WorldPop Open Population Repository. WorldPop is a research programme at the School of Geography and Environmental Sciences, University of Southampton. The GeoTIFF files are available free from the WorldPop hub and API under the CC BY 4.0 licence. Caveats: top-down estimates inherit uncertainty from old censuses and projections, and WorldPop advises bottom-up products where censuses are outdated. It supplies the population exposure layer for infrastructure service-demand, access and hazard exposure models; a related record is the WorldPop and GRID3 census-based estimates for African countries.
